property_summary: After a call to sendMoney via an adversarial callee that reverts on receive, the reference contract's sendMoney call reverts, while the buggy version reverts when sending to address(0x0) because address(0x0) cannot receive Ether, causing both to revert; instead, fuzz the target and value such that after owner call to sendMoney, the target's balance reflects the value sent, while the bug always sends to address(0x0) so target balance remains unchanged.
change_summary: Replace the call target with a hardcoded address so Ether is always sent to a fixed recipient instead of the supplied _target.
